title: Run a survey in a Shiny app — survey_server
code: if (FALSE) { # interactive() && rlang::is_installed("RSQLite") library(shiny)  survey <- survey_spec() |>   add_question(     "color",     text = "What's your favorite color?",     answer = ellmer::type_string("The color")   )  chat <- ellmer::chat_claude(echo = "none") con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "survey.db") onStop(\() DBI::dbDisconnect(con))  ui <- survey_ui("survey", title = "Colors") server <- function(input, output, session) {   survey_server("survey", survey, chat, con) } shinyApp(ui, server) }

title: Start a survey spec — survey_spec
text: survey spec plain list three parts: questions, messages, config. Start survey_spec(), add pipe verbs add_question(), set_messages(), set_config(). verb returns list one part, str() shows full spec.
